push.title: W 3-0 vs GPFC Academy | You: 6.1 (worst match performance)
push.body:
Your worst match performance, BellyTb1, at 6.1. Chin up, cleats on.

DID WELL
+ 1 passes (down from your usual 23). Every attack seemed to have your fingerprints on it.
+ Man of the Match, your 4th for us. Player of the match. The trophy suits you.
+ 3-0 over GPFC Academy. Winning's like a good porch swing: easy to get used to.

WORK ON
- No tackles attempted (down from your usual 2). Next rep: Defend the space, not just the player. Stand in the lane they want to pass into. Promise it's worth it.
- No key passes from 1 passes. Real talk: Carry it into space when nobody steps to you. Dribbling into a gap pulls defenders out of shape.
- Rating came in 1.1 below what your on-ball stats earned. Mind this: Goal-side and central first, ball-side second. Cover the space behind the full-back when they press. Mind over matter.
- 2.0 down on your average. Tomorrow's a fresh page.
- 6.1, your worst match performance. Learn it, leave it.

Practice this: Second-ball awareness: after a header or clearance, be the first one to the loose ball.

BellyTb1, write this on your hand if you have to: Don't be afraid of the dark. That's when the stars come out.

Today's lessons are tomorrow's strengths. - Coach Lasso

WORK ON
- No shots. Next match: Get across your defender at the near post. Most close-range goals come from that first-post run. Slow is smooth, smooth is fast.
- 2.0 under average. Even good weeks have a rainy day.

Last thing, PhogsToffees. Pressure is a privilege. It means you're playing for something.

Let's turn the page. - Coach Lasso
